theme_strategy.name: Latte & Espresso
theme_strategy.description: A dual-mode warm aesthetic inspired by coffee culture. Light mode mimics the warmth of a morning latte (creams, beiges), while dark mode reflects the depth of an evening espresso (rich browns, dark roasts).
theme_strategy.mode_behavior: Toggle available, defaults to Light Mode (Morning Shift) vs Dark Mode (Evening/Night Shift) based on system time if possible, otherwise user toggle.

primary.description: Rich Coffee Brown - Main actions, active states, heavy text

secondary.description: Latte Foam - Secondary buttons, active item backgrounds

accent.description: Caramel / Roasted Bean - Highlights, notifications, important tags

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES: `npm install lucide-react sonner date-fns clsx tailwind-merge framer-motion` (or yarn add)
SETUP_FONTS: Import 'Manrope' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in index.css.
THEME_SETUP: Configure tailwind.config.js with the provided palette colors (primary, secondary, accent, etc.).
LAYOUT_RULE: Dashboard MUST use a Bento Grid layout. Do not use simple rows. Use col-span-X classes to create visual interest.
INTERACTION_RULE: All checklist items must be large enough for a thumb tap (min-height 48px).
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA. The coffee brown on beige is generally safe, but check lighter text.
MOTION: Add 'framer-motion' for checklist completion animations (e.g., a subtle scale-up and color change to green).
NAVIGATION: Create a Sidebar navigation for Tablet/Desktop. Bottom nav is acceptable for Mobile only.
NOTES_FEATURE: Use a 'sticky note' visual metaphor for the shift notes section (soft yellow/beige bg with shadow).
TESTING: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, checklist items).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers/sidebars.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Micro-animations for every interaction (hover, click, toggle).
